title: Stream Error
description: Payload of the stream:error envelope. Tells the requesting client that audio streaming could not be set up, with a machine-readable code and a message safe to show a producer (Requirement 15.6).

code.description: Machine-readable failure code, for example stage_creation_failed or participant_token_issuance_failed.

message.description: Human-readable failure reason, safe to display in the client.

envelopeType.description: Envelope type that triggered the failure, when the error answers a specific inbound envelope.

validationErrors.description: Rendered schema validation failures, when the failure was a payload that did not match its schema.
